items.title: Smith after Sturm Graz win: 'That was a Bournemouth performance'
Minus 17 to European dreams as Bournemouth fairytale continues
items.description: It was a night 127 years in the making as Bournemouth added another chapter to their fairytale with victory in their first-ever European home game.

items.title: Bournemouth beat Sturm Graz in first ever home European game
items.description: Bournemouth's history-making season continued on Thursday as they played - and won - their first-ever home European match, beating Sturm Graz 3-0 in the Europa League.

items.title: O'Neill 'delighted' with second half despite heavy Celtic loss at Benfica
items.description: Celtic showed second-half fight but were ultimately outclassed away to Benfica as they were beaten 4-1 in the Europa League.

items.title: Rutter scores twice as Brighton win big and go top in Conference League
items.description: Georginio Rutter scored twice and set up one as Brighton thrashed Kauno Zalgris 4-0 to get their Conference League campaign off to a winning start.

items.title: Sadiki nets late winner as Sunderland survive huge scare at Torreense
items.description: Sunderland survived a huge scare as they came from behind to clinch back-to-back Europa League victories with a 2-1 win over Torreense following Noah Sadiki’s 93rd-minute winner.
